title: Two Sum
prompt: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. Assume exactly one solution exists.

title: Valid Parentheses
prompt: Given a string containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid (properly opened and closed, correctly nested).

title: Merge Intervals
prompt: Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals and return an array of the non-overlapping intervals covering all the input intervals.

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
prompt: Given the root of a binary tree, return the level order traversal of its nodes' values (i.e., from left to right, level by level).

title: LRU Cache
prompt: Design a data structure that follows the constraints of a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache. Implement get and put in O(1) average time.

title: Word Break
prompt: Given a string s and a dictionary of strings wordDict, return true if s can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of one or more dictionary words.

title: Number of Islands
prompt: Given an m x n 2D binary grid which represents a map of '1's (land) and '0's (water), return the number of islands.

title: Top K Frequent Elements
prompt: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements.

title: Course Schedule
prompt: There are numCourses courses labeled 0 to numCourses-1, with prerequisite pairs. Determine if it's possible to finish all courses.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
prompt: Given an integer array nums, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
prompt: Given two sorted arrays nums1 and nums2, return the median of the two sorted arrays in O(log(m+n)) time.

title: Trapping Rain Water
prompt: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
